rules: This is a valuation registry, not an effect executor or a new recipe pool. Output times/counts summarize source text; conditional alternatives are not unconditional grants.
An ordinary single source part retains its normal main-recipe ingredients, even when that part later grants other parts. Do not divide that source cost across future rewards.
Every mapped batch part uses its fixed one-part reference. Do not divide the actual batch or generator cost, apply a discount twice, or sum credits before rounding each sold part.
Aliases sharing a reference have identical sale values at the same shop prices. Copies inherit the original reference and any generated fixed-value parameter, without another discount.

Unmapped ordinary single outputs use their own normal main recipe. Generic plain Shield grants use the plain-shield family. Unknown special generated types must receive an explicit mapping rather than silently borrowing their generator cost.
Rarity and acquisition source are not price multipliers. Extra Heat/Charge/HP/part payments are not material ingredients in the sale formula.
Prices use current shop resource prices. No shop price is selected here. Selling remains subject to existing unused-part and unloading eligibility; a pending delivery cannot be sold.
All family quantities are integers, including ceiling to whole materials. No fractional gameplay resource amount is introduced. These references never charge the player resources.
Numerical resale balance, generator income and interactions with discounts/repeated deliveries require simulation and human beta testing.
